scope: Independent source-image and scripted-runtime qualification of exact frozen integrated CLI. No physical device, emulator, remote host, install, competitor runtime or new UI/GPU measurement. Installer status applies only to this offline scope.

matched_input_output_check.comparison: All response keys and values are identical after removing ONLY capture_ms,read_ms,total_ms,seconds. This includes complete words, confidences, bounding rectangles, lines, matches, source/engine metadata, passes/cache/fallback fields, detail/truncation and count fields.
matched_input_output_check.limits: Subset-labelled offline corpus,eng+osd installed; preserves existing misses and is not general OCR accuracy or50-language engine qualification.

paired_fresh_recognition.method: Three persistent native MCP servers; identical freshly changed-pixel PNG bytes and selector/mode per trial; round-robin variant order; first engine call separate from4 subsequent warm fresh images. Caller OpenMP settings unchanged/recorded. Native request/reply boundary and /proc sampler identical. No competitor/device run.
paired_fresh_recognition.content_cache_guard: Every paired read changed actual RGB content outside labelled target and asserted cached=false,engine_runs>0. Same PNG SHA/selector/mode used across three servers, variant order rotates each trial.
paired_fresh_recognition.interpretation: Median matched final/old elapsed ratio0.339 for standard worker (66.1% lower elapsed; old/new factor2.95) and0.810 for explicit-system CLI (19.0% lower). Standard worker faster in 24/24 pairs; explicit-system CLI faster in 23/24 pairs. Six balanced case/mode groups with4 warm samples each; local results, not universal speed guarantees or competitor performance.

memory_tradeoff.interpretation: Warm standard-worker resident footprint 82.9MiB versus old 11.1MiB; keeping the model ready raises steady/cache-hit memory. Fresh sampled peak 85.5MiB vs old 100.9MiB. Report both; not a general memory reduction.
memory_tradeoff.method: 10ms sampled /proc process-tree sum, shared pages counted per process; can miss short-lived peaks and excludes GPU.
memory_tradeoff.idle_cleanup: Not remeasured in this speed/accuracy matrix; separate lifecycle tests by the implementation and fault-validation lanes cover cleanup/recycle. No long-lived leak claim here.

host_conditions.contention: Root full CTest and ARM Docker/qemu build were running. Live paired requests reduce order/load drift, but absolute values are not isolated-host ceilings. Historical417 baseline comparison is explicitly unpaired; use live paired results for the final old/new statement.

tesseract.standard_route: TOMACCO_TESSERACT absent; PATH resolves /usr/bin/tesseract after hardware traps
tesseract.custom_route: same executable explicitly selected with TOMACCO_TESSERACT

engine_and_environment.same_model_and_executable: Exact executable/model SHA recorded for old and candidate; standard route removes TOMACCO_TESSERACT, custom selects exact /usr/bin/tesseract. Caller OMP_THREAD_LIMIT/OMP_NUM_THREADS absent for both. No global environment/package changes.
engine_and_environment.no_component_causality: Final code combines worker, PNG pipeline and child-completion changes; these measurements do not assign the gain to a single change.
